page_title: NIC 1-5 MAR | Nice v Marseille 21/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' Jeremie Pignard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Marseille was in an offside position.
89' Substitution. Neal Maupay (Marseille) has come on for Igor Paixao.
86' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
85' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
83' Marseille keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
81' Nice showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
80' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Yehvann Diouf is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

79' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
78' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nice, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
77' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Isak Jansson (Nice) replacing Sofiane Diop.
77' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Leonardo Balerdi is replaced by CJ Egan-Riley (Marseille).
77' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Bernard Nguene (Nice) replaces Mohamed-Ali Cho.
77' Here comes a substitution. Robinio Vaz (Marseille) is brought on as a substitute for Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang.
76' Jeremie Pignard interrupts the game. One of the players from Marseille won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Nice are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
75' The ball possession at the moment is 55:45.
74' 1 - 5 Fantastic team goal! Igor Paixao (Marseille) was set free in the area by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang and fired low past Yehvann Diouf. 1:5.

72' Jeremie Boga (Nice) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
70' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Angel Gomes will be replaced by Matt O'Riley (Marseille).
70' Geoffrey Kondogbia goes off the pitch and Bilal Nadir (Marseille) comes on.

69' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball is out of play and Marseille manage to earn a corner.
68' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Kojo Peprah and he is replaced by Ali Abdi (Nice).
68' Here is a change. Terem Moffi is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Jeremie Boga (Nice).
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Salis Abdul Samed will be replaced by Morgan Sanson (Nice).
66' A quickly taken corner by Nice.
66' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) sends a lovely cross into the penalty area and Melvin Bard attempts to score after getting on the end of it.
64' Nice are ruled offside.

63' 1 - 4 A perfect lofted pass from Sofiane Diop finds Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Jeffrey De Lange had no chance of stopping that. 1:4.
61' Igor Paixao (Marseille) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
60' Igor Paixao (Marseille) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang with a fine lofted pass.
59' Nice players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
58' 0 - 4 It's 0:4! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang feeds Timothy Weah (Marseille) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the left side of the net.
56' The current number of shots on goal is 6:7.
55' Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
54' A player from Marseille commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

53' 0 - 3 Leonardo Balerdi passes to Mason Greenwood (Marseille), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 0:3.
53' Igor Paixao (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
51' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle and it's Sofiane Diop (Nice) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

50' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nice are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
49' Great touch by Terem Moffi (Nice) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
48' The free kick from long range, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

48' Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
47' Igor Paixao (Marseille) picks up an injury.

47' What a chance that is! Melvin Bard (Nice) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
46' The whistle blows and Jeremie Pignard starts the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.

45+4' Igor Paixao (Marseille) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.

45+3' Juma Bah (Nice) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Jeffrey De Lange pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag and Nice will take a corner.

45+2' A pass travels right across the box to Terem Moffi (Nice) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the middle of the goal, but Jeffrey De Lange denies him with a decent save.
45+1' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Terem Moffi (Nice) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jeffrey De Lange comes off the line to clear the ball away.
42' The ball goes out for a corner. Nice can continue in their attacking effort.

42' Terem Moffi (Nice) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Jeffrey De Lange, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The linesman makes the right call and Nice will have a corner.
42' The ball is out of play. Nice win a corner kick.

41' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Yehvann Diouf pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
40' Marseille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
38' Although Ali Abdi (Nice) is just on the bench, Jeremie Pignard has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
38' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) is the recipient.
33' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Mason Greenwood (Marseille) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Yehvann Diouf. He makes it 0:2.
33' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
33' Corner kick. Nice will have an opportunity.
32' Emerson (Marseille) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

31' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Yehvann Diouf makes a simple save. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
30' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
29' Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.

28' Marseille are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
27' Nice will take a corner kick.
27' Terem Moffi (Nice) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. It will be a corner kick for Nice.
25' Ball possession – 53:47.
24' Terem Moffi (Nice) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

23' Terem Moffi (Nice) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but Jeffrey De Lange is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
23' One of the players from Nice times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
22' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
20' A player from Nice commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
19' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nice was in an offside position.
18' Yehvann Diouf (Nice) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
17' Ooh that was close! Igor Paixao (Marseille) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
16' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Jeffrey De Lange is prepared to thwart his effort.
14' Antoine Mendy (Nice) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
11' 0 - 1 Benjamin Pavard plays a neat ball into the path of Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), who makes room for a shot and fires the ball into the back of the net! 0:1.
11' The ball goes behind for a corner. Marseille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Superb touch by Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) as he receives a precise pass into the box, but the goalkeeper stops the ball as it heads towards the top of the net. Brilliant save!
11' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
10' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
9' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nice.
8' The Nice players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
7' Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jonathan Clauss (Nice).
6' Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jeremie Pignard who sees an offensive foul.
5' There's a distinct lack of options for Antoine Mendy (Nice), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post.
3' A player from Marseille commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
2' Emerson (Marseille) works the corner short.
1' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Marseille win a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
Marseille will kick the game off.
Jeremie Pignard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
